summary:
bash: # Step 4: Configure ACLs on /srv/shared

# Set current ACLs:
# Group research: rwx
setfacl -m g:research:rwx /srv/shared

# User alice: rwx
setfacl -m u:alice:rwx /srv/shared

# User bob: rwx
setfacl -m u:bob:rwx /srv/shared

# Others: no permissions
setfacl -m o::--- /srv/shared

# Set mask to rwx (so ACL entries aren't restricted)
setfacl -m m::rwx /srv/shared

echo "Current ACLs set"
getfacl /srv/shared
